page: Microsoft Azure M48ps_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The hardware configuration is provisioned with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64). The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high allocation of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

The instance does not bundle any local disk storage or hardware accelerators, operating with zero GPUs and no onboard NVMe drives. Persistent and operating system disk operations rely entirely on remote disk attachments through Azure Premium Storage capability. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, utilizing standard virtual networking infrastructure for connectivity.

Targeted at workloads with extensive memory footprints relative to compute capacity, the M48ps_v4 offers high memory density on energy-efficient ARM hardware. It is structured for memory-bound applications including large in-memory databases, distributed memory caches, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise data processing frameworks compatible with ARM64 architectures that do not require local ephemeral scratch storage.
